basic_info.description: With an A+ location on the corner of Pacific and Steiner in the heart of Pacific Heights, this extraordinary property is a once-in-a-generation offeringa classic marriage of California Colonial Spanish architecture and today's contemporary lifestyle, coupled with magnificent gardens on a buildable adjacent lot. Near Alta Plaza Park and just blocks from the boutiques and restaurants of Fillmore and Union Streets, this grand corner estate offers timeless style and rare opportunity.    Spanning three levels, the home features soaring ceilings, elevator access throughout, and abundant natural light. A dramatic foyer leads to formal living and dining rooms, perfect for entertaining. The oversized kitchen is the heart of the home, with generous counter space, a center island, cozy sitting area, and ample storage for all your culinary needs.    Upstairs, all bedrooms include en suite baths, plus a flexible den. The lower level offers a media room, guest bedroom, and large laundry area. The adjacent lot is a private garden retreat with a gazebo and potential for future development (subject to approvals).
